mutants.name: start-new-session-dropped
mutants.why: dropping start_new_session=True from the no-agent respawn leaves the daemon attached to the ssh session; t4 asserts the keyword is present

mutants.name: agent-loaded-branch-removed
mutants.why: removing the _agent_loaded guard causes Popen under a loaded agent, spawning two daemons where the second exits on the flock; t3 asserts _kickstart is called and Popen is not

mutants.name: keepalive-rendered-true
mutants.why: rendering KeepAlive as always-true means a guarded stop (exit 0) is restarted by launchd; t1 asserts KeepAlive == {SuccessfulExit: False}
mutants.anchor:
<key>KeepAlive</key>
    <dict>
        <!-- A clean stop (exit 0) stays stopped; a crash is restarted. -->
        <key>SuccessfulExit</key>
        <false/>
    </dict>

mutants.name: exit-timeout-below-drain
mutants.why: ExitTimeOut below _DRAIN_TIMEOUT means launchd SIGKILLs before the daemon finishes draining in-flight threads; t1 asserts ExitTimeOut > _DRAIN_TIMEOUT
